description: NaLuTiO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcm space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.93 Å. Lu is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Lu-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.70 Å. Ti is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.48 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Lu and one Ti atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Lu, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five equivalent Na and one Ti atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Lu and two equivalent Ti atoms to form distorted edge-sharing OLu₂Ti₂ tetrahedra.
